The '''gYvX Shield Generator''' was a [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] system produced by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]]. The [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] was commonly installed on [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] and around [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="HS" />
